const input = $json;
const success = input.testOnly
  ? input.familyContext.child.ageMonths === 8 && input.familyContext.child.ageLabel === '8 mois'
  : true;

return [{
  json: {
    testOnly: Boolean(input.testOnly),
    status: success ? 'TEST_SUCCESS' : 'TEST_FAILED',
    message: success
      ? `FamilyHubOS workflow OK. Child age: ${input.familyContext.child.ageLabel}. Route: ${input.route}.`
      : 'FamilyHubOS workflow test failed.',
    route: input.route,
    responseText: input.planning.responseText,
    telegramReplyMarkup: input.telegramReplyMarkup,
    selectedCategory: input.selectedCategory,
    selectedTopicId: input.selectedTopicId,
    selectedTopic: input.selectedTopic,
    createNotionPage: Boolean(input.createNotionPage),
    createNotionTopic: Boolean(input.createNotionTopic),
    telegram: input.telegram,
    familyContext: input.familyContext,
    meeting: input.meeting,
    calendarPayload: input.calendarPayload,
    researchStatus: input.sourceValidation.status,
    nextRealIntegrations: ['Google Calendar create event', 'Web search provider', 'LLM structured summary']
  }
}];
